testcase.name: each mode sets the torch and the ImageCapture's flash mode as the table says
a camera with no flash unit is never asked, and the mode stays Off
closing with the torch on turns it off and leaves flashMode at Off
after the bind, the session is Off and the ImageCapture's flash mode is OFF
a tap cycles Off, Auto, On, Torch and back to Off
before a camera is bound there is no unit, and a request changes nothing
with no flash unit, Auto and On are refused like Torch, and nothing reaches the ImageCapture or the torch
a failed torch request reports what the torch actually is
a failed torch request with the torch unlit leaves Auto and On standing
setting Off turns the torch off
On, then close, then a new bind - the session reports Off and the new ImageCapture is OFF
